# Website sitemap

**Live site:** https://tailbone.netlify.app (to become https://tailbonetreatment.com) · **Demo with sample data:** https://tailbone.onrender.com

**Machine-readable sitemap for Google and Bing:** `/sitemap.xml`. It lists 51 public pages and articles and is regenerated by every build.

**Last updated:** 6 November 2026

---

## 1. Public website (for patients)

**Launch phase 1 (6 Nov 2026):** these are built but hidden until switched on in `content/launch.json`: the online booking form (Book shows Call, WhatsApp and Email instead), My appointments and check-in, Refer a patient and Partner page, Doctor at your place, and the "Share your story" form. Their old links go to the Book page.

**In Hindi:** the main pages are also at `/hi/` (home), `/hi/coccydynia`, `/hi/treatment`, `/hi/doctor`, `/hi/locations`, `/hi/faq` and `/hi/book`. The English ⇄ हिंदी switch in the header goes to the same page in the other language. Articles, My appointments and the other pages are in English.

```
Home  /
│   Sit down again without the pain: hero, key numbers, why sitting hurts (animated),
│   how treatment works (4 steps), meet Dr Rajveer, at a glance, book
│
├── Tailbone pain  /coccydynia
│     What it is · symptom self-check · self-care tips
│     6 fact tiles (how common, causes, symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, outlook)
│     Dr Rajveer's five rules · the research in numbers (table)
│     Go deeper: "Dr Rajveer explains" (3 articles) and "What the research shows" (3 articles), link to all articles
│     Red flags · sources
│
├── Treatment  /treatment
│     How a visit works · why patients choose us · Instagram videos
│
├── Doctor  /doctor
│     Dr Rajveer Singh: qualifications, conditions treated, newspaper coverage, patient stories
│
├── Clinics  /locations
│     ● New Delhi (open) · ● Online (open) · ● At your place (on request) · ● Lucknow (opening soon) · ● Bengaluru (closed)
│     Colour-coded tabs with a one-line status, map, opening hours
│
├── FAQ  /faq
│
├── Book  /book
│     Clinic → day → time → details (+ optional "About you" and referral code) → (online payment) → appointment number, patient ID,
│     QR code, Add to Google Calendar. Without the server: sends a WhatsApp request instead.
│
├── Blog  /blog/                   10 articles published (20 held back for phase 2), with search and topic filters
│     ├── /blog/<article>.html      picture, topics, "On this page", WhatsApp share, sources,
│     │                             booking box, "Keep reading" (3 related articles)
│     └── /blog/a/<article>         articles written in the dashboard (pictures, video, audio)
│
├── In the news  /press.html       11 newspaper clippings (2013–2016), full-size viewer, coccyx.org mentions
├── Patient stories  /stories.html all stories + "Share your story" (patient ID + appointment number)
│
├── Doctor at your place  /home-visit.html   request a visit in your city (7 days ahead; you cover costs)
├── Refer a patient  /refer.html  rewards, who can join, partner sign-up, partner terms
├── Partner page  /partner.html   partner log-in: referral ID, share link, referrals (initials), payments
│
├── My appointments  /manage.html  sign in with appointment number + phone
│     ├── personal home: "Hi Asha", next appointment, visits, pain now, pain chart, patient ID
│     ├── about you (age, city, work…) · refer a friend (own referral ID, rewards)
│     ├── appointment card (QR, IDs, print / save as PDF), payment receipt
│     ├── online consultations: Join call (from 15 min before), how to get ready, camera & mic test
│     ├── reschedule / cancel (shows the refund first)
│     ├── your documents (shared by the clinic) · optional upload of earlier reports (off for now)
│     └── your data: copy, correction, deletion · WhatsApp updates on/off
│
├── Follow-up check-in  /checkin.html?t=…   from a WhatsApp link: pain 0–10, better / same / worse
├── Terms, fees & refunds  /policies.html
├── Privacy  /privacy.html          privacy notice (DPDP / GDPR) + data-rights request form
└── Page not found  /404.html       menu, article search, links to Book, Tailbone pain, FAQ, My appointments
```

**On every page:**
- **Menu:** Tailbone pain · Treatment · Doctor · Blog · Clinics · Book. The phone menu also has Questions, Patient stories and My appointments.
- **Top bar:** open or closed right now, and the phone number.
- **Phone bottom bar:** Call · WhatsApp · Book.
- **Footer:** contact details, clinics, opening hours and useful links (including Doctor at your place and Refer a patient).
- **"As featured in"** (home page): each newspaper opens its own clipping.
- **Cookie choices:** Google Ads and Analytics run only after "Accept".

**Behind the scenes:**
- `/robots.txt`
- `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` (guides for AI assistants)
- `/.well-known/security.txt`
- every old tailbonetreatment.com address redirects to its new page (43 rules)

## 3. Clinic dashboard (staff)  `/admin`

```
Sign in (email + password + two-factor code)
│
├── Overview          today first · 4 headline numbers · money today (collected, still to collect, month, 30 days)
│                     · tomorrow's reminders (send all one by one) · follow-ups due · patients needing attention
├── Appointments      filter and search · confirm · complete (+ follow-up) · reschedule · cancel · refund
│                     · "Received ₹…" at the desk · Start call / send video link · receipt · history
├── Inbox             changes made by patients · messages waiting to be sent on WhatsApp
├── Follow-ups        due · overdue · upcoming · done (with undo)
├── Patients          search
│     └── Patient     contact, about the patient, referred by, private notes, consent, pain chart, visits, follow-ups,
│                     documents (add, share, delete), export or erase data
├── Stories           approve, feature, edit or reject patient stories
├── Website           what the website shows, changed without a developer (phase 1):
│                     Videos (YouTube: add, title, pages, order, show/hide, remove; Instagram: which pages)
│                     · Announcement bar (message, link, colour, start and end dates, preview)
│                     · Hours & contact (opening hours, also used for online booking; phone, WhatsApp, email)
│                     · FAQ (add, edit, reorder, hide, delete) · Clippings (upload a photo, edit, reorder, hide)
│                     · History (every change: who, when, restore an earlier version)
├── Instagram         add, reorder, hide or remove Instagram posts (shown on Treatment; Home and Doctor if chosen)
├── Blog              + New article (editor with live preview, pictures, video, audio, drafts)
│                     · every article by number: show or hide on the website
├── Referrals         partners and their referral IDs · approve sign-ups · what to pay · record payments
│     └── Partner     details, share link, patients referred, rewards (withdraw / restore), payments
├── Doctor at your place   requests by status · WhatsApp / call · notes and status
├── Ads & insights    where bookings come from (Google Ads, referrals, links) · campaigns ·
│                     age, gender, city, work, sitting, pain duration, how they heard (totals only)
├── Payments          totals and list by date · download for the accountant (CSV)
├── Privacy           data requests (copy, correction, deletion), completed within 7 days
├── Settings          tabs: Fees & policies (with change history) · Holidays · Online consultations
│                     · Calendar · My account (two-factor, password) · Data & backups (export, backups, security log)
└── Control panel     ★ super admin: website switches, staff accounts and their sections
```

**Website switches in the Control panel:**
- online booking
- online payments
- patient reschedule and cancel
- follow-up check-ins
- patient stories
- Instagram videos
- symptom self-check
- documents in My appointments
- patient uploads (off)
- referral programme
- Doctor at your place
- WhatsApp bubble

Privacy rights always stay on.

## 4. Demo  https://tailbone.onrender.com

| Try as | Link | What you see |
|---|---|---|
| Doctor | `/admin?demo=1` | Full dashboard with sample patients: today's visits (one online), a pain alert, follow-ups, a refund, a story to approve, a privacy request, documents, receipts |
| Partner | `/partner.html` → "Try as a demo partner" | City Ortho Hospital: referral ID, two referred patients, ₹50 to be paid, last month's payment |
| Patient | `/manage.html?demo=1` | Asha Verma: online review in 3 days (Join call panel, camera test), exercise plan to download, receipt, reschedule, cancel, data requests |

No real messages, emails or payments are sent in the demo, and it resets every day.
